charge.description: The charge of the molecule (0 for neutral, -1 for anionic, +1 for cationic)

sameAs.description: Chemical identifiers for the molecule with validated patterns

iupacName.description: IUPAC systematic name of the chemical compound

inChIKey.description: Hashed version of InChI for easier searching

image.description: URL or file path to the 2D or 3D structure of the molecule

imageAttribution.$comment: Local extension: not a schema.org property of MolecularEntity. When serialising JSON-LD, express `image` as an ImageObject and map `creditText`, `license`, `usageInfo`, `source` and `citation` onto it, or drop this block.
imageAttribution.description: Credit for the depiction in `image`: who published it, where it came from and under what terms. Creative Commons sources follow the CC recommended practices for attribution, https://wiki.creativecommons.org/wiki/Recommended_practices_for_attribution ; sources that publish their own citation guidelines, such as PubChem, follow those instead and add `usageInfo` and `citation`

creditText.description: Ready-to-use plain-text credit line, with the licence and source URLs spelled out so it stands alone where markup cannot follow it

license.description: The terms the depiction is offered under

spdx.description: SPDX licence identifier, e.g. CC-BY-4.0. Absent when the terms are not an SPDX-listed licence, as for PubChem's web policy

name.description: Full name of the licence or usage terms

url.description: Link to the licence deed or the usage terms

usageInfo.description: Terms of reuse that are not a licence deed, e.g. PubChem's citation guidelines for structure images. Absent when the licence in `license` already states them

source.description: The database that published the depiction

name.description: Name of the source database, e.g. LIPID MAPS®, ChEMBL, PubChem

url.description: Home page of the source database

sameAs.description: The record page the depiction belongs to. For PubChem this is the record's 2D-Structure section, as its citation guidelines prescribe

identifier.description: The source's own citable form of the record id, e.g. CID 2244. Absent when the source asks for nothing beyond the record URL

citation.description: The paper the source asks to be cited alongside its data. Absent when the source asks for no citation

name.description: The reference as the source prints it

identifier.description: Identifier of the cited work, e.g. doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1059

url.description: Resolvable link to the cited work

properties.description: Additional properties for the molecule not covered by bioschema_properties
